svg.aria-label: Artificial Intelligence in Practice: A free 84-page handbook that walks from "what is a token" to working agents with tools. Local models, RAG, agents, MCP, fine-tuning, real API costs, security, prompting as a method, and how to test AI systems so they do not embarrass you in front of a customer. Written for people starting out in AI, with every example tested by hand. CC BY-NC-SA: share it, translate it, teach with it.
